<thought>Carbonyl groups show characteristic 13C NMR signals typically between ~165–220 ppm. The provided 13C spectrum has its highest shift at 160.80 ppm and no peaks in the carbonyl region, suggesting the molecule lacks carbonyl carbons. To confirm, an IR spectrum would show a strong C=O stretch near 1700 cm⁻¹ if any were present; the absence of such a band would support the conclusion. However, based on the carbon NMR data alone, the number of carbonyl groups is zero.</thought>
